title: Asymptotics-guided learning and symbolic regression for dispersive resonances
summary: We study resonance prediction in dispersive media, formulated as nonlinear spectral problems for volume integral operators. The main idea is to use asymptotic analysis not only as a baseline approximation, but also as a guide for constructing predictive correction models. We learn the residual between asymptotic and reference resonances using features suggested by the subwavelength expansion, including the logarithmic scales specific to two dimensions.
